confidence_note: all values are quoted from first-party Ionic pages. The free Hobby credit allowance, build wall-clock cap, retention and egress terms are unverified: behind a sign-up. Native build usage is metered in plan credits; the credit total on the free Hobby plan is not published on any page read.

free_tier.stated: a free Hobby plan that requires an Ionic Account and is for trying some of Appflow's features; new customer sales of Appflow were discontinued on February 11, 2025, and all Appflow features and services sunset effective December 31, 2027
free_tier.notes: the vocabulary has no term for a build-credit allowance, so mixed stands in; native build usage is stated in credits, with 1 Android build minute = 1 credit and 1 iOS build minute = 2 credits

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-object or build wall-clock cap stated in the first-party pages read

retention.stated: unverified: no build or artifact retention period stated in the first-party pages read

egress.terms: unverified: no egress allowance or price for hosted builds stated in the first-party pages read

interface_detail: builds trigger from a connected git repository or from the Appflow dashboard; the Appflow CLI drives native builds and deployments from an external CI system with a Personal Access Token; the Appflow CLI is available to enterprise customers only
endpoint: unverified: no public API endpoint is stated on the pages read
tooling: hosted native build stacks for iOS and Android; Capacitor, Cordova, React Native and native projects; no Mac hardware needed for iOS builds because builds run in Ionic's cloud
chaining: a push to a connected git repository or a call from the Appflow CLI starts a hosted native binary build, then publishes to the Apple App Store or Google Play Store or delivers a Live Update. The CLI can be driven from Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Travis or CircleCI, but the build itself runs on Appflow runners.

limits.value: native build usage is metered in plan credits: 1 Android build run time minute = 1 credit and 1 iOS build run time minute = 2 credits; if a credit limit applies to a plan, usage is tracked toward it on the dashboard
all Appflow features and services sunset effective December 31, 2027, and new customer sales were discontinued on February 11, 2025
the Appflow CLI is available to enterprise customers only

binding_note: new customer sales of Appflow were discontinued in February 2025 and all features sunset on December 31, 2027, so a reader cannot start a new hosted lane after that date, which binds before any build-credit allowance is reached

identity_cost.detail: an Ionic Account is required; the personal account settings page shows a Name, Email and Username and a changeable password. The sign-up page is a login wall and its exact form fields are unverified: behind a sign-up. No card, phone or identity document was seen at signup.

reliability_note: Ionic warns that applications still relying on Appflow infrastructure after the December 31, 2027 sunset may experience build pipeline failures and live update failures resulting in whitescreens

notes: A hosted mobile CI/CD service. The free Hobby plan is unverified in its credit total and build cap because the sign-up page is a login wall and these values are behind a sign-up.
